The '''common thranta''', also referred to as simply '''Alderaan thranta''', was the most common and well-known of the [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] species, indigenous to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The species was able to escape extinction even after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|loss of their home]], as some of the animals had been shipped to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
The beasts had strong wing muscles and internal air sacs which allowed them to stay aloft while carrying large amounts of weight, while a long tail with a dorsal fin aided their movement in flight,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> making them perfect aerial mounts.<ref name="codex" /> Like the other subspecies, they were trainable and were used as personal transport with a seat placed on the back of the beasts head.<ref name="alderaan" />
[[File:ThrantaNest-SWTOR.png|thumb|Nest of a ''common thranta''|left]]
Common thrantas were born from [[Egg/Legends|eggs]], and had nests in which the eggs were kept, usually several at once. Nesting places could vary from grasslands to high mountain peaks. Thranta handlers built artificial nests at thranta stations, where creatures rested between flights.<ref name="alderaan">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>
[[File:ThrantaKillikRelic-SWTOR.png|thumb|Skull of a ''common thranta'' on a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] pedestal]]
Common thranta's skull structurally closely resembled that of an [[Unidentified extinct giant thranta species|Ancient Giant thranta]], only substantially smaller in scale. The skulls were sometimes used as decorations,<ref name="skull">{{TORcite|type=other|Decoration: "Adolescent Thranta skull"}}</ref> and held a significance in [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] culture.<ref name="relic">{{TORcite|type=other|Killik Relic found on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>

=== Breeds ===
A large breed known as the [[giant thranta]] was identical to other common thrantas but, of course, larger in size.<ref name="anthology">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> This is not to be confused with the [[Giant Red thranta]] and the [[Great thranta]], which were distinct species.

== History ==
{{Quote|Now, if anyone wishes to see live thrantas, they must go to Bespin. I hope the creatures thrive there, without Imperial cruelty.|[[Hari Seldona]]|<ref name="Illustarated">[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]</ref>}}
[[File:Thranta_Riders.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Thranta riders on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].]]
Early Alderaanian colonists made extensive use of thrantas, using them for personal and military transport.<ref name="codex" /> By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], common thrantas were widely used on Alderaan as a [[Air taxi|taxi]] transport connecting various locations across the planet, though they did not completely replaced common taxi-speeders.<ref name="alderaan" /> Across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] a silhouette of the common thranta was often used a taxi symbol, displayed on yellow stands marking taxi stations.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Their popularity on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] generated an enormous demand for the animals on Coruscant; thousands of thrantas were transplanted, but they were unable to survive the city-world's heavy air pollution. Afterwards, the Alderaanians have refused to export the thrantas offworld and hunting them on Alderaan became strictly forbidden. This has only made thranta smuggling and thranta poaching more appealing in certain circles.<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Thranta}}</ref>

Following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], when [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] broke out on Alderaan, common thrantas played a vital role in the conflict by transporting troops and supplies across the battlefield,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> as an alternative to [[Unidentified speeder van model|speeder vans]].<ref name="alderaan" />

A private common thranta was included in [[Alderaan Noble Estate]], a type of real-estate property available on Alderaan during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]], big enough to require its own inner transportation.<ref name="stronghold">{{TORcite|exp=strongholds|type=other|[[Alderaan Noble Estate]]}}</ref>
[[File:CommonThrantaArt.png|thumb|Depiction of the ''common thranta'', made by referencing the holographic streams of the [[Holographic Zoo of Extinct Animals|Coruscant Zoo]]]]
Some young common thrantas<ref name="wildlife" /> were transplanted from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as possible beasts of burden to be used among the clouds of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], thus allowing the species to survive [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's destruction]]. On Bespin, they came to be associated with [[Thranta Rider]]s,<ref name="Young knights">[[Young Jedi Knights: Trouble on Cloud City]]</ref> and became a tourist attraction, participating in monthly [[sky rodeo]]s of breathtaking feats, in which the talented alien riders leaped out into the open sky, falling until the thrantas swooped down to the rescue.<ref name="Illustarated" />
